tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yid mngon gyi legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las blo gsal mig 'byed rigs pa'i thur ma zhes bya ba'i legs bshad bzhugs so// byams pa'i khang bzang rab yangs par/ /blo gros legs bshad 'bum phrag gis/ /rnam gsal mkhas pa gar byed pa'i/ /rgyal sras 'jam mgon bla ma rgyal/ /'di na blo ldan don gnyer bar/ /yid mngon legs bshad bdud rtsi 'di/ /sbyin no skal ba bzang po dag /dga' ba'i yid kyis nyan par byos/ /zhes brjod nas/ 'dir yid mngon gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa la/ don tshan gsum ste/ mkhas rmongs kun la mkho byed gzhung gi 'brel/ dpyod ldan mkhas pa dga' byed dka' gnad gcod/ blo gsal gzhon nu'i kha 'byed rigs pa'i 'od 'phreng bkod pa'o/ /don tshan gsum po 'di la/ yid mngon la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i ma 'khrul ba'i yid kyi rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa rnam grangs la/ yid mngon/ yid kyi mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum gyi tshad ma/ yid shes su gyur pa'i mngon sum/ ma 'khrul ba'i yid blo dang lnga don gcig gsum pa sgra bshad ni/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon lta bu ste/ rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum yin pas na/ yid mngon zhes bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas ming btags pa yin no/ /bzhi pa dbye ba la/ rang rig gi yid mngon/ gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon/ don rig yid mngon gsum mo/ /yid mngon la 'di gsum du 'byed dgos te/ rnam 'grel dang rigs gter gzhung gi dngos bstan la don rig yid mngon gtso bor bstan kyang / sbas don rigs pas kha phye na gzhan gnyis po de yang mi 'byung kha med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po rang rig yid mngon la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/

rang gi bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i 'dzin rnam de'o/ /'o na rang rig gi bdag rkyen la gzhan dbang zhes bshad pa ma yin nam snyam na/ rang rig la thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yid dbang dang dbang po gzugs can gang yang med pas bdag rkyen gzhan dbang zhes spyi ming nas btags pa yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa rnam grangs ni/ rang rig rang rig gi mngon sum/ rang rig gi yid mngon/ 'dzin rnam/ kha nang bltas kyi rig pa/ kha nang kho nar phyogs pa'i rig pa/ 'dzin rnam rkyang pa'i shes pa/ gzung rnam ma yin pa'i shes pa/ rang rig gi tshad ma dang bcu po don gcig dbye na/ myong bya'i sgo nas rang gi myong byar gyur pa'i rtog pa nyams myong gi rang rig dang / rang gi myong byar gyur pa'i rtog med shes pa nyams myong gi rang rig gnyis/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas/ sems dang sems byung du gyur pa'i rang rig gnyis/ rten gyi sgo nas/ skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi rang rig gnyis/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas/ rang gi bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i rang rig dang / rang gi bdag rkyen ting nge 'dzin la brten nas skyes pa'i rang rig gnyis/ dang po ni rang rig phal cher yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor mngon sum du gyur pa'i rang rig de'o/ /kha cig dbang mngon nyams myong gi rang rig de bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can la brten nas skyes zer te/ 'khrul pa'i gtam yin pas rna ba dgab bo/ /sgra bshad ni/ rtog pa nyams myong gi rang rig de/ rang gi bdag rkyen yid dbang las skyes shing / rang gsal du skyes tsam yin pas na/ rang yid mngon zhes bya'o/ /khyad chos la yul gyi khyad par la/ rang rig la yul med zer ba dang / rang las rdzas gzhan pa'i yul med zer ba de/ go ba bzang yang gzhon nu dag gis skyong dka' bas/ rang rig la rang yul rgyang chad gzung 'dzin gnyis su phye ba'i yul de med ces bya'o/

/bdag rkyen gyi khyad par/ rang rig la bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can dang / yid dbang gang yang med ces smra na go ba bzang yang / rang rig la kho rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen bem shes gang yang med la/ 'on kyang kho'i bdag rkyen gzhan dbang tsam zhig yod cing / de gang yin zhe na/ kho yid shes yin par khas blangs pa'i gnad kyis kho'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i yid dbang de las ma 'das so/ /ngo bo'i khyad par la/ rang rig 'di sems sems byung gang yang min byas na 'thad kyang de blor mi shong bas/ rang rig la sems sems byung gnyis char yod ces khas longs shig mtshan gzhi ji ltar snyam na/ gtso sems myong byed kyi rang rig sems dang / sems byung rnams myong byed kyi rang rig sems byung yin zer ba las thabs med do/ /ngo bo'i khyad par/ kha cig shes pa yin na/ rang rig yin pas khyab zer te/ ha cang thal ches so/ /sgra bshad la khyab pa ma 'cha' zhig kha cig rang rig yin na/ rang nges tshad ma yin pas khyab zer te/ gzhung gi tshig zin yang / rang re la tshad ma gnyis char yod do/ /'o na ji ltar snyam na/ dbang mngon nges pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi dbang mngon nyams myong gi rang rig de rang nges tshad ma yin la/ dbang mngon ma nges pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi dbang mngon nyams myong gi rang rig de gzhan nges tshad ma yin no/ /des gzhan la yang 'gre'o/ /kha cig shes pa thams cad kho rang la rang rig mngon sum yin zer te/ phyogs gcig nas go ba bzang ste/ phyogs gcig nas mig gya med kyi 'gros ltar song 'dug go /des na/ 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ bum 'dzin rtog pa de kho rang la mngon sum ga la yin te/ khos rang la lta ba'i bya ba tsam yang ma byas pa'i phyir te/ khos bum pa'i don spyi la bum par zhen pa tsam las med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rtog pa phal cher gcig gis/ kho bo rang gi ma rig pa'i gnad dgongs nas/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rtags can rjes dpag de kho rang gi ngo bo la blo rig gang yang min gsung ba'i byin rlabs snying la 'jug par gyur cig/

༈ /gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon la/ mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ khyad chos so/ /dang po ni/ gzhan rig tsam gyi rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i yid kyi rig pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon gyi tshad ma rang rig don rig gang rung ma yin pa'i yid mngon/ don rig ma yin pa'i gzhan rig mngon sum bzhi don gcig gsum pa ni/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes de la/ gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon zhes bya ste/ kha phyi bltas kyi yid mngon yin kyang / rang gi bzung don rig pa ma yin pas na/ de ltar bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'dir rang rig tu bshad pa min nam snyam na/ rigs pa'i dpung mi bzod na gzhung gi tshig zin gyi 'khar la ma 'khra zhig/ //bzhi pa dbye ba la skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gzhan rig mngon sum gnyis yod/ lnga pa khyad chos la/ 'o na gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon la/ khyad chos ji ltar dgos snyam na/ rang gi gzung don mi rig cing gzhan rig mngon sum yin pa zhig dgos so/ /mtshan gzhi ji lta bu snyam na/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes rnams yin la/ kho bo cag ni/ rmi lam shes par gyur pa'i ma 'khrul shes rnams kyang mtshan gzhi yin no/ /'o na de 'dra mi srid snyam na/ 'o na rmi lam nyams myong gi rang rig de rmi lam ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa yod ces kho bo smrar ro/ /des na/ shes pa/ rig pa/ blo/ tshad ma/ mngon sum/ yid mngon sogs rdzas spyi phal cher gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon yin no/ /gsum pa don rig yid mngon la/ mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ khyad chos so/ /dang po ni/ gzung don can gyi ma 'khrul ba'i yid kyi rig pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ don rig yid mngon/ don rig yid mngon gyi tshad ma/ gzung don can gyi yid mngon/ gzung yul can gyi yid mngon/ dmigs rkyen can gyi yid mngon/

rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i yid mngon/ don rig tu gyur pa'i yid mngon/ don rtogs su gyur pa'i yid mngon bcu po don gcig gsum pa ni/ gzugs 'dzin gyi yid mngon de la/ don rig yid mngon zhes bya ste/ rang gi gzung don rig pa'i yid shes yin pas de ltar btags pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na/ yul gyi sgo nas gzugs 'dzin yid mngon sogs lnga/ rten gyi sgo nas skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi don rig yid mngon gnyis/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas/ sems sems byung gnyis gnyis yod do/ /dper na/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon du gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa de/ gtso sems yin la/ de'i 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung kun 'gro lnga dang / yul nges lnga sogs sems byung du gyur pa'i don rig yid mngon no/ /lnga pa khyad chos la/ rkyen gsum gyi khyad chos/ skye tshul gyi khyad chos/ yul gyi khyad chos/ gzhung las bstan tshul gyi khyad chos so/ /dang po la/ don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen/ de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen/ de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen/ de'i lhan cig byed rkyen dang nyer len gyi ngos 'dzin so sor bshad pa dang / dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ lag rjes dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi phyi'i skye mched rags pa de/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ so sor phral nas rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin yid mngon la gzugs kyi rnam pa gtod byed kyi gzugs rags pa de rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ rang 'bras sgra 'dzin yid mngon la sgra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi sgra rags pa de/ rang 'bras sgra 'dzin yid mngon dmigs rkyen mtshan nyid yin pa sogs 'gre'o/

/de yang rang 'bras zhes pas rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skyed byed min pa rnams/ rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen yin pa gcod/ gzugs 'dzin gyi rnam pa gtod byed ces pa des/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi bdag rkyen yid dbang lta bu des/ de bskyed nus kyang / de la gzugs kyi rnam pa gtod byed min pas na/ de'i dmigs rkyen ma yin no zhes ston par byed/ gzugs rags pa zhes pa de'ang / gzugs can la phra rags gnyis yod pa'i/ gzugs can phra ba rnams de'i dmigs rkyen yin pa gcod do/ /'o na/ gzugs can phra rags kyi khyad par ji ltar snyam na/ 'di la grub mtha'i gnad shes dgos te/ bye brag smra ba kha che'i lugs la/ rdzas rdul phra rab ni phyogs kyi cha med kyi rdul phran yan gar ba/ zla med kyi rdul phran yan gar ba gnyis gnad gcig pas/ de gzugs su ma grub pas gzugs can min la/ gzugs kyang min no/ /des na gzugs phung / gzugs/ gzugs can/ bem po rnams gnad gcig pas/ rdzas rdul phra rab de/ gzugs phung min zhing / phung po lnga dang / skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams bco brgyad po gang yang min la/ 'on kyang 'dus byas ni yin no zhes khas len no/ /grub mtha'i rang skyon du thug nas de las smra thabs ma rnyed pa yin no/ /des na mdo sde pa'i skabs 'dir yang / phyi don bden grub khas blangs pa'i rang skyon gyi gdon gyis zin pas/ g.yas bcos g.yon 'theng gi rnam pa zhig 'dug kyang / re zhig 'di ltar khas blangs te/ rang rtsom byed dbus dang phyogs drug gi rdul gyi rgyu las byung ba'i rdul du grub pa de/ rdul rags pa'i mtshan nyid/ rdul rags pa'i rtsom gzhi gang zhig rang zlas dben pa'i rdul du grub pa de/ rdul phra mo'i mtshan nyid/ des na/ rdul phra mo dang / thogs med kyi rdul/ bstan med kyi rdul/ rdul phra rab/ zla med kyi rdul phran yan gar ba/

phyogs kyi cha med kyi rdul phra rab/ rdzas rdul phra rab rnams gnad gcig cing / des na gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang / /zhes pa'i gzugs can gyi chung mtha' mthar thug de/ bye brag smra bas de la yang rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus dgos so zhes khas blangs pa'i gnad kyis/ de rags pa yin gyi rdul phran mtshan nyid pa min par khas blangs 'dug kyang / mdo sde pa'i skabs 'dir/ de rdul phran mtshan nyid par khas blangs nas/ de bdun 'dus pa las rdul phran gcig 'byung zhes pa'i rdul phran gyi ming can de yan chad rags pa yin pas/ de skabs kyi rdul phran gyi ming can de/ rdul phran mtshan nyid pa min par khas blang dka' ba'i gnad las rang grol yin no/ /zhes kho bo smra'o/ /des na rdul phran de la dbye na/ rdul phra rab gnyis tsam 'dus pa'i gong bu nas drug tsam 'dus pa'i gong bu'i bar yod zer ba rnam dpyod chung ba yin te/ rdul phra rab bdun ma 'dus bar du zla med yin la/ gnyis tsam 'dus na zla bcas su gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rdul phran gnyis 'dus nas gsum ma 'dus pa dang / drug 'dus nas bdun ma 'dus pa'i bar gyi rdul ni med de/ rdul bdun 'dus pa'i tshe/ cig car du 'dus pa yin gyi/ rim gyis 'dus pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na rdul rab bdun 'dus tsam nyid nas rags pa gnas gyur pa yin gyi rdul phra rab drug man chad rdul 'dus pa'i tha snyad mi thob cing / rags pa brtsams zin nas kyang de'i tshogs pa na zla med kyi rdul phra rab yod zer ba'i 'chol gtam mi smra ba ni/ lha dang bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs dang rnam dpyod kyi shes rab kho na'i drin yin no/ /'o na rdul phra rab de la dbye na gzugs sogs don lnga dang / rdul rdzas brgyad sogs kyang khas len nam snyam na/ bye brag smra ba kho ni khas mi len la/ mdo sde pa kho gang zer brtag par bya bas re zhig sba bar bya'o/ /rdul rags pa la dbye na/

phyi'i rdul rags pa dang / nang gi rdul rags pa gnyis/ yang na/ rgyu gzugs su gyur pa'i rdul rags pa dang / 'bras gzugs su gyur pa'i rdul rags pa gnyis so/ /dbye sgo dang po phyi'i rdul rags pa la/ gzugs sogs don lnga/ nang gi rdul rags pa la mig sogs dbang po lnga yod cing / mig sogs dbang po lnga po de/ gzugs can yin yang mdo sde pa'i lugs 'dir gzugs min la/ de rten bcas dang de mtshungs gnyis yod kyang / rags pa dang thogs bcas sogs yin pas khyab la/ gzugs sogs don lnga la'ang / rags pa dang thogs bcas yin pas khyab pa bye smra ltar khas blang dgos pa 'dra'o/ /gang ltar yang / rdul rags pa/ thogs bcas kyi bem po/ bsags rdul/ bsags rdul phra rab zla bcas kyi rdul rnams gnad gcig go /'o na gzugs kyi skyed mched yin na/ gzung don yin pas khyab bam snyam na/ kha cig ma khyab ste/ 'di la'ang de mtshungs kyi gzugs kyi skyed mched yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zer mod/ lung gi rjes 'brang gi sde pa dang / bye brag smra ba'i skabs su de ltar yin yang / rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi skabs 'dir mi rigs te/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis kyis ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ gzugs kyi skyed mched la gzung don gyis khyab ste/ sgra'i skye mched la gzung don gyis khyab pa'i phyir te/ rang 'bras sgra 'dzin dbang mngon gyi thos byar mi rung ba'i sgra med pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig ma khyab ste/ ri rab kyi khong gseng na yod pa'i sgra gzugs sogs thos pa'i nyan shes dang / mthong ba'i dbang yid mngon sum med pa'i phyir snyam na/ ma grub ste/ de dag mig shes kyis mthong ba dang / rna bas thos pa'i gang zag mang du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta ma yin na 'dus byas yin na rang 'bras skyed pa'i don de nus pa yin pas khyab pa khyed kyis khas blang bar mi nus te/ bskal pa 'jig dus kyi gzugs skad cig ma cha med pas/

rang 'bras bem po yang mi bskyed rang 'bras shes pa gcig kyang mi bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye sgo gnyis pa rgyu gzugs su gyur pa'i rdul rags pa ni/ 'byung ba bzhi la byed/ 'bras gzugs su gyur pa'i rdul rags pa ni/ reg bya'i skye mched ma gtogs pa'i gzugs can gyi skyed mched lhag ma dgu la byed/ reg bya la de gnyis cha tshang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa rnam grangs ni/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen/ de'i gzung yul/ de'i gzung don rnams don gcig gsum pa sgra bshad ni/ gzugs skad cig ma gnyis pa de la/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen zhes 'jog te/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs pa'i yul yin pa'i sgo nas/ de skyed pa'i rkyen yin pas de ltar bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa dbye na/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen du gyur pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang lnga yod/ lnga pa lag rjes ni/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po gzugs skad cig ma gnyis pa'i rnam ldan du skyes pa de/ gzugs skad cig ma gnyis pa des/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po'i dmigs rkyen byas pa'i byed las sam lag rjes yin no/ /gnyis pa don rig yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ lag rjes dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon rkyen gsum gang rung gang zhig rang 'bras don rig yid mngon yul 'dzin nus su skyed byed kyi dbang po'i rnam par shes pa de/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon mngon sum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ so sor bral na/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi rkyen gsum gang rung gang zhig gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gzugs 'dzin nus su skyed byed kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i rnam rig de/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/

des rigs 'gre gnyis pa rnam grangs ni/ don rig yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen/ de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag tu gyur pa'i dbang po'i rnam rig de'i nyer len du gyur pa'i dbang po'i rnam rig gsum don gcig gsum pa sgra bshad ni/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang por gyur pa'i gtso sems de la/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen zhes bya ste/ des de'i gtso bo'i rgyu byas pa'i sgo nas/ 'bras bu de la thun mong ma yin par dbang bsgyur bas na de ltar bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa dbye ba la/ rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen/ rang 'bras sgra 'dzin yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen sogs lnga'o/ /lnga pa lag rjes ni/ don lnga 'dzin pa'i yid mngon lnga/ rang rig yul gzugs sogs 'dzin nus su skyes shing / yid mngon zhes pa'i ming don gnas pa de/ de rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po'i rnam shes lnga po de'i byed las sam lag rjes yin no/ /gsum pa don rig yid mngon gyi mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen la mtshan nyid rnam grangs/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ lag rjes dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi rkyen gsum gang rung gang zhig rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gsal rig tu skyed byed kyi rig pa de/ rang 'bras don rig yid mngon gyi mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ bral na yang rigs 'gre/ gnyis pa ni/ don rig yid mngon gyi mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen dang / de'i dngos rgyur gyur pa'i shes pa gnyis don gcig gsum pa sgra bshad ni/ de lta bu'i rgyu 'bras gnyis char rigs par mtshungs pas na mtshungs/ chos gzhan gyis bar ma chod pas na de ma thag pa/ rgyu des 'bras bu de skyed par byed pas na rkyen te/ mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen zhes bya'o/

/bzhi pa dbye ba la/ don rig yid mngon gyi mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen du gyur pa'i sems dang sems byung gnyis yod do/ /lnga pa lag rjes ni/ don rig yid mngon gsal rig tu skyes pa'i cha de/ de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi lag rjes yin no/ /bzhi pa don rig yid mngon gyi nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen gyi khyad par ni/ don rig yid mngon gyi mtshungs pa de thag rkyen du gyur pa'i dbang shes de la/ sems sems byung gnyis yod pas/ gtso sems des nyer len dang / sems byung des lhan cig byed rkyen byed pa yin no/ /des na don rig yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yin na/ de'i nyer len dang de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gnyis char yin pas khyab/ de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen yin na de gnyis yin pas ma khyab ste/ de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen du gyur pa'i sems byung rnams kyis ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa skye tshul gyi khyad chos la/ skye tshul/ tshad ma sgrub tshul/ skye ba'i gnas skabs dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ spyir gang zag gcig gi rgyud la mngon sum nyi shu cig car skye ba srid te/ don lnga 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa lnga/ don lnga 'dzin pa'i yid mngon skad cig ma dang po lnga/ de bcu nyams myong gi rang rig bcu ste nyi shu tham pa cig car du skye ba zhig yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar skyes pa'i tshe/ nyi shu po de skye 'gag gnas gsum cig car du byed dgos te/ cig car skyes phyin chad/ cig car du gnas shing cig car du 'gag pa de 'dus byas kyi gnas tshul yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / yid kyi mngon sum du ma yang / /dbang shes bzhin du rang rig gcig /ces so/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang / rgyun gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ don rig yid mngon tshad ma yin te/ rang gi gzung don la gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar yang / rang mtshan 'dzin phyir 'khrul pa med/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa la/ don rig dbang mngon la rgyun yod de/ dbang mngon snga mas nyer len byas nas phyi ma skye ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /don rig yid mngon la rgyun med de/ don rig yid mngon snga mas nyer len byas nas phyi ma skye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /don rig yid mngon rang gi nyer len dbang mngon las skye dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / dbang po gzugs can las dbang skye/ /zhes sogs dang / yid dbang las ni yid dbang min/ /zhes so/ /des na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma bcu skye/ bcu gcig pa phan chad mi skye pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po de/ rgyun bcas kyi shes pa yin te/ de la rigs 'dra snga ma'i rgyun med kyang / phyi ma'i rgyun yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na de chos can/ khyod skad cig ma snga mas nyer len byas pa las khyod skad cig ma phyi ma skye ba yod par thal lo zer na/ ha cang tshig la 'khris pa yin pas ma khyab bo/ /'o na de skad cig ma bcu pa de rgyun bcas kyi shes pa yin par thal/ de la rigs 'dra snga ma'i rgyun yod pa'i phyir ro zer na/ 'jig rten grags pa dang bstun na 'dir ma khyab ces zer ro/ /rigs pa shes pa'i ngor 'dod lan btab kyang don la gnas par sems so/ /gsum pa skye ba'i gnas skabs la/ mkhas pa gzhan gyi lugs rnams dgag rang lugs tshul dang mthun par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyan mkhan po'i rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig dang por gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skye/ de rjes gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po skye zhes sogs spel nas skye bar 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ mkhas pa snga ma'i gsung 'gros las/ dbang mngon chu bo'i rgyun dang mtshungs/ /yid mngon chu bo'i zegs ma 'dra/ /zhes dbang mngon chu bo'i rgyun ltar rgyun chags su skye ba dang /

yid mngon dbang mngon gyi logs su chu'i zegs ma 'thor ba ltar skye bar bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ yang rgya gar chos mchog dang / de'i rjes su 'brang ba las dang po pa dang dge ldan pa sogs/ dbang mngon gang yin pa de'i rgyun mtha' kho nar yid mngon gcig skye zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dbang mngon skad cig ma bcu skye ba'i tshe/ dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis sogs dang dus mnyam du yid mngon skye ba'i rkyen gsum tshang 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / spel ma dang ni rgyun gyi mtha'/ /zhes sogs so// //gnyis pa rang lugs la/ bdag rkyen 'gros gsum skye ba'i tshul/ dmigs rkyen 'gros lngar skye tshul/ yid byed 'gros bdun skye ba'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon bcu rgyun chags skye ba'i tshe/ de'i rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po de/ grogs gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyi zla med du skye ste/ de'i dus su gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skye ba'i bdag rkyen ma tshang ba'i phyir te/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skye ba de/ bdag rkyen dbang mngon la ltos dgos pa gang zhig gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po'i nyer len du gyur pa'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de skabs kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa de dang dus mnyam du gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad gcig ma dang po skye ba yin te/ gzugs skad cig ma gnyis pa des/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa dang / gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po gnyis kyi dmigs rkyen thun mong ba byas/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang por gyur pa'i sems byung gcig gis/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po'i lhan cig byed rkyen dang / gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu byas nas de gnyis dang de gnyis nyams myong gi rang rig gsum dus mnyam du skye ba'i phyir te/

des na dbang po dbang shes kyi/ /rgyu yin yid kyi rkyen du 'gyur/ /rang rig yin phyir rgyud gzhan med/ /des na mngon sum 'gros gsum pa/ /zhes so/ /'di la bdag rkyen gyi 'gros gsum zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mig dbang gzugs can pa skad cig ma gnyis pas thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byas nas/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa dang / gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang por gyur pa'i gtso sems kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen byas nas gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po gnyis cig car du skye ba yin zhing / de gnyis nyams myong gi rang rig de gnyis dang cig car du nges par skye ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na de gnyis nyams myong gi rang rig de'i bdag rkyen ci snyam na/ de ni bdag rkyen gzhan dbang las skye zhes pa'i gnad go dgos te/ myong byed rang rig rnams ni/ myang bya shes pa de'i bdag rkyen gyi gzhan dbang las skyes zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dper na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon nyams myong gi rang rig de/ kho rang gi myang bya gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa des/ kho'i bdag rkyen byas nas skyes zhes pa ni ma yin te/ de'i bdag rkyen ma yin/ 'on kyang myang bya dbang mngon de'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa de'i dbang gis skye ba yin te/ des myang bya dbang mngon bskyed pa'i stobs kyis myong byed rang rig de yang skyes pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston yin no/ /gnyis pa ni dmigs rkyen gyi sgo nas 'gros lngar skye tshul ni/ rang rig la dmigs rkyen med pas 'gros dpyad du med la/ dbang yid la dmigs rkyen yod pas dmigs rkyen gyi sgo nas 'gros lngar skye tshul yod de/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dmigs rkyen gzugs skad cig ma gnyis pa dang /

sgra skad cig ma gnyis pa sogs lngas dmigs rkyen byas nas/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po dang gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa gnyis/ de bzhin du sgra 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po dang sgra 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa gnyis sogs cig car du skye ba'i phyir/ 'di la dmigs rkyen gyi sgo nas 'gros lnga zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dmigs rkyen gzugs sogs skad cig ma gnyis pa lngas dmigs rkyen byas nas don lnga 'dzin pa'i mngon sum lnga cig car du skye ba'i phyir ro/ /ldog pas phye na don lnga 'dzin pa'i mngon sum bcu cig car du skye ba'i 'gros zhes kyang bya ste/ gzugs skad cig ma gnyis pas dmigs rkyen byas nas dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa dang / gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig ma dang po gnyis sogs bcu cig car skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / yul gyi 'gros dpyad na rang rig la yul gzhan med pas 'gros lngar 'gyur la zhes so/ /gsum pa yid byed sgo nas bdun du skye tshul ni/ mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi sgo nas 'gros bdun du skye tshul yod de/ 'gros lnga po de'i steng du/ dbang yid nyams myong gi rang rig gnyis phral nas bsnan pas bdun cig car du skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la yid byed kyi 'gros bdun zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ don lnga 'dzin pa'i mngon sum lnga la mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen sems byung yid byed re re yod pa bzhin du myong byed rang rig gnyis la'ang / mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen kun 'gro lnga'i nang tshan yid la byed pa re re yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / dbang po dang yid gnyis kyi yid la byed pas snga ma gnyis bsnan na 'gros bdun du 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /dbang po dang yid gnyis kyi yid la byed pa snga ma gnyis bsnan na zhes pa ma dag pa yin gyi/

dbang po dang yid gnyis kyi yid la byed pas snga ma gnyis bsnan na zhes 'don dgos te/ 'dir mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen yid byed kyi sgo nas/ 'bras bu rang rig gnyis bsnan pa yin gyi/ rang rig gnyis yid byed snga ma ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam dpyod yod na bsam dgos so/ /gsum pa yul gyi khyad par la/ tshur mthong gi don rig dbang yid rnams kyi yul yin na phyi don dang shes pa gang rung yin pas khyab ces pa spyir btang lam pa yin gyi dmigs bsal la khyab pa mi 'cha' bas/ don rig mngon sum rnams kyi gzung yul yin na/ phyi don yin pas khyab ces bya'o/ /bzhi pa gzhung las bstan tshul ni/ tshad ma mdor/ yid kyang don dang chags la sogs/ /rang gi rtog pa med pa yin zhes pa de/ don rig yid mngon dang / rang rig yid mngon gnyis dngos su bstan pa yin te/ yid kyang zhes pa des/ dbang mngon rnams rtog bral gyi mngon sum yin par ma zad/ yid shes 'ga' zhig kyang rtog bral gyi mngon sum yin no zhes bstan nas/ 'o na tshul ji ltar snyam na/ don dang zhes pa des don rig yid shes rnams/ yul gzugs sogs don lnga la rtog bral gyi mngon sum yin la/ chags la sogs/ zhes pa des/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dang / bde sdug sogs nyams myong gi rang rig yid shes rnams ni yul chags sdang sogs dang bde sdug sogs la rtog bral gyi mngon sum yin no zhes bstan 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam 'grel las/ de phyir dbang po'i rnam par shes/ /zhes sogs dang / rnam nges las/ dbang shes de ma thag rkyen las/ /zhes sogs dang / rig gter las/ yul dang dbang shes rnam gnyis las/ /zhes sogs rnams kyis ni/ don rig yid mngon 'ba' zhig dngos su bstan pa yin te/ de phyir dbang po'i rnam par shes/ /de ma thag rkyen las byung can/ /yid ni yul gzhan nyid 'dzin byed/ /ces pa'i tshig zur gyi yid ni/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum dang /

dbang shes de don de ma thag /'dzin par byed pa yid kyang ngo / /zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi/ yid kyang ngo zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum dang / yul dang dbang shes rnam gnyis kyi/ /de ma thag las skyes pa'i yid/ /ces pa'i tshig zur gyi/ skyes pa'i yid ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum rnams dang don rig yid mngon don gcig pa'i phyir dang / de phyir dbang po'i rnam par shes zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dbang po'i rnam par shes pa dang / dbang shes de don de ma thag /ces pa'i tshig zur gyi dbang shes zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dbang po'i rnam par shes pa dang / yul dang dbang shes rnam gnyis kyi/ zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi dbang shes zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dbang po'i rnam par shes pa yin na rang gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i don rig yid mngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dang / de'i mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen gnyis cha yin pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / yid ni yul gzhan nyid 'dzin byed/ /ces pa'i tshig zur gyi yul gzhan zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzungs yul dang / dbang shes de don de ma thag /ces pa'i tshig zur gyi de don zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzung don dang yul dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzung yul rnams yin na/ rang dmigs rkyen du byed pa'i don rig yid mngon gyi dmigs rkyen yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gis ni/ yid mngon gyi brda chad gsal bar bkod pa'i rab tu byed pa dang po rdzogs so// //da ni de dag la rim bzhin dogs pa gcad par bya ste/ mtshan nyid rnam grangs de ltar byas pa la/ kho na re/ gtso sems su gyur pa'i dbang po chos can/ khyod yid mngon yin par thal/ khyod yid kyi mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod yid dbang gi mngon sum gang zhig yid dang yid dbang don gcig pa'i phyir na/ brda chad bzhag mtshams shes dgos pas ma khyab bo/ /dang po der thal/

khyod yid dbang gang zhig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma khyab na/ de chos can/ khyod yid dbang gi mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod gtso sems kyi mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod mngon sum gang zhig sems byung gi mngon sum ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab ste/ shes pa yin na sems sems byung gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma grub na/ sems byung du thal lo/ /yang de chos can/ khyod yid kyi mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod yid kyi tshad ma gang zhig khyod yid kyi rjes dpag min pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod yid kyi shes pa gang zhig khyod yid kyi tshad min gyi blo ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod yid kyi dngos po gang zhig shes pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir ma khyab/ dang po der thal/ khyod yid kyi shes pa gang zhig dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod yid kyi yod pa yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod yid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar zer na/ khyod rang la/ gtso sems su gyur pa'i yid mngon chos can/ khyod dbang mngon yin par thal/ khyod dbang po'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ khyod yid kyi dbang po'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod yid dbang gang zhig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nus mngon sogs sgra ji bzhin mtshungs so/ /yang kha cig na re/ khyod kyi mngon sum yod par thal/ khyod mngon sum gang zhig khyod yin yod pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ khyod kyi tshad ma yod par thal/ khyod tshad ma gang zhig khyod yin yod pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ khyod kyi shes pa yod par thal dang / khyod kyi dngos po yod par thal dang / khyod kyi shes bya yod par thal la snga ma bzhin sbyar te khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dbang mngon du gyur pa'i chos can gyis gshog rtags dang po der thal/ khyod dbang mngon yin pa'i phyir te/

chos can yin pa'i phyir te/ de yod pa'i phyir/ dbang mngon du gyur pa'i gtso sems yod pa'i phyir te/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa ma 'khrul ba de de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid mngon yod par thal/ rtags gnyis pa der thal/ gtso sems su gyur pa'i dbang mngon de de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar ma khyab na'ang / gong gi chos can des gshog rtags rnams bsgrubs zin pas go sla/ 'dod na/ dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid kyi mngon sum yod par thal/ dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid kyi tshad ma yod pa gang zhig dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid kyi rjes dpag med pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa khyod kyi shes pa yod par thal gyi thal 'gyur la ma khyab na'ang des mtshon no/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa la ma khyab byas pa la/ dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid mngon chos can zer na/ 'dod lan 'debs so/ /'o na dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid kyi shes pa yod par thal/ der gyur pa'i yid kyi dngos po yod pa gang zhig der gyur pa'i yid kyi bem po yang med/ der gyur pa'i yid kyi ldan min 'du byed kyang med pa'i phyir zer na/ spyi khyab yod la sgos khyab med kyi mu min pas khyab bo/ /rtsa ba'i rtags dbang mngon du gyur pa'i yid kyi dngos po yod par thal/ der gyur pa'i yid kyi dbang po yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang yid shes su gyur pa'i tshad ma yin na/ yid mngon yin pas khyab par thal/ dbang shes su gyur pa'i tshad ma yin na dbang mngon yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na ma khyab bo/ /'dod na rjes dpag gis ma nges kyang yid mngon yin na drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes par gyur pa'i yid mngon sum yin dgos par thal/ de yin na drug pa yid shes su gyur pa'i mngon sum yin dgos pa'i phyir na ma khyab bo/ /'dod na yid mngon du gyur pa'i sems byung gis ma nges so/ /yang rang rig chos can/

de phyir dbang po'i rnam par shes/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad de'i dngos bstan gyi yid mngon yin par thal/ khyod yid mngon yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab bo/ /'dod na/ don rig yid mngon yin par thal lo/ /ma khyab byas pa la/ khyod gzhung de'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod gzhung de'i dngos bstan gyi yod par gyur pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de'i dngos bstan gyi tshad mas dmigs par gyur pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir na/ bar 'tshangs kyi skyon yin pas ma khyab/ rtags der thal/ khyod de'i dngos bstan gyi tshad ma'i gzhal byar gyur pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod don rig yid mngon gyi bye brag gzhal byar gyur pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro zer na/ khyod rang la rjes dpag chos can/ khyod mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod/ mngon sum rtog dang bral bar ni/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i dngos bstan gyi yod pa'i gyur par tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i dngos bstan gyi tshad mas dmigs par gyur pa'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes mtshungs so/ /yang rang rig chos can/ khyod snga ma gnyis la bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod la/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod dbang mngon dang yid mngon gang rung yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ mngon sum bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i yid mngon ni/ don rig yid mngon kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ khyod mngon sum gyi skad dod pra ti mak+sho/ zhes pa'i sgra bshad du yod pa'i mngon sum yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ khyod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum dang rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum gang rung du thal lo/ /rtsa bar ma khyab byas pa la/ 'o na/ phyi ma gnyis la 'jug pa 'ba' zhig go

/zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum yin na/ snga ma gnyis la bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod la/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum ma yin dgos par thal/ rang rig yin na snga ma gnyis la bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod la/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma khyab na/ bsal ba la khyab pa yod par thal/ snga ma gnyis la bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod la/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum yin na/ mngon sum gyi sgra bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod pa'i mu yin pas khyab/ phyi ma gnyis la 'jug pa 'ba' zhig go /zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi mngon sum yin na/ mngon sum gyi sgra 'jug tu yod la/ bshad du med pa'i mu yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar 'dod byas pa la/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyis shog ma grub na der thal/ khyod rang rig dang rnal 'byor mngon sum gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma khyab ste/ snga ma gnyis la bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod ces/ don rig dbang yid gnyis/ mngon sum gyi sgra bshad 'jug gnyis ka yod par bstan pa'i shugs kyis/ phyi ma gnyis la 'jug pa 'ba' zhig go /zhes pa'i phyi ma gnyis po de/ don rig mngon sum la yin pa gzhir bzhag gi rang rig dang rnal 'byor mngon sum gnyis la go bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam dpyod yod na de tsam gyis chog go /blo gros ma rdzogs pa 'ga' zhig skyon 'dis gnod kyi dogs nas/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi don rig mngon sum med zer ro/ /de yod par thal/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lha'i mig gi mngon shes yod pa'i phyir ro/ /der thal/ mngon shes drug ldan gyi sangs 'phags yod pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas par khas 'che nas rtags ma grub rang kha nas mi 'don las che'am/ kha cig skyon de srungs ma 'dod nas sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon de/ bdag rkyen ting nge 'dzin la brten nas skyes pa yin pas/

bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can las ma skyes zer ro/ /de chos can/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes par thal/ khyod dbang shes yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod dbang mngon yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te dbang shes yin pa'i phyir la ma khyab na/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lha'i mig gi mngon shes chos can/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes par thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes pa'i phyir te/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen lha'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes pa'i phyir te/ khyod lha'i mig gi mngon shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kho na re/ sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi lha'i mig gi mngon shes chos can/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan bzhi po gang rung gi sas bsdus kyi lha'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod lha'i mig gi mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bsam gtan sa pa'i gzugs dwangs pa/ /rtag tu rten bcas ma tshang med/ /ces pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir na ma khyab las 'os med/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ khyod zag bcas kyi mngon shes yin par thal lo/ /yang sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can la brten nas ma skyes par thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen ting nge 'dzin la brten nas skyes pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ rtags der thal/ khyod sangs 'phags kyi rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab bsam pa la de la khyab pa yod par thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i gtso sems la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum ma yin par thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i sems byung la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/

ma khyab zer na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs 'dzin yid mngon chos can gyis shog de thal de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ der thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags ma grub na de chos can/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i sems byung la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum yin par thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i sems byung ting nge 'dzin la brten nas skyes pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas skyes pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod mnyam gzhag tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'dir mkhas pa phal che ba dag yid mngon yin na don rig yin pas khyab/ ces zer ro/ /'o na gson cig khyod don rig yid mngon yin par thal/ khyod yid mngon yin pa'i phyir/ khyod yid shes su gyur pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dbang shes su gyur pa'i mngon sum yin na dbang mngon yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gong gi rtags der thal/ khyod yid shes gang zhig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ shes pa gang zhig dbang shes yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ de chos can/ khyod yid shes yin par thal/ khyod drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod rnam shes tshogs brgyad gang rung gang zhig kun gzhi dang nyon yid gnyis 'dir khas mi len pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ rig pa yin na rnam shes tshogs drug mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang rung yin pas khyab par thal/ kun gzhi dang nyon yid gnyis khas mi len pa gang zhig de khas len pa'i tshe rig pa yin na rnam shes tshogs brgyad mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ sa paṇ+ḍi tas rig pa yin na rnam shes kyi/ /tshogs brgyad nyid las 'da' ba med/

/ces pa'i gzhung 'di khra lam mer dran pa'i phyir/ 'dod na rang rig gis bshog gal te yid shes su gyur pa'i mngon sum yin na/ yid mngon yin pas ma khyab zer na/ rang rig chos can/ yid mngon yin par thal/ khyod dbang mngon dang yid mngon gang rung gang zhig dbang mngon ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod mngon sum gang zhig mngon sum de la dbang mngon dang / yid mngon gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ shes pa de la dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir ro/ /yang tshur mthong lha'i rgyud kyi mi yi sems shes pa'i mngon shes de chos can/ khyod don rig yid mngon yin par thal/ khyod yid mngon yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod mngon sum bzhi po gang rung gang zhig khyod dbang mngon yang min/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yang min/ rang rig mngon sum yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po gnyis chos can gyis 'grub/ phyi ma ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod kha nang bltas kyi shes pa yin par thal/ khyod rang rig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mi nus te khyod kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab zer na/ shes bya chos can/ de 'dra'i mngon shes de mi'i sems la rang rig mngon sum yin par thal/ de rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ de mi'i sems nyams su myong ba'i rang rig mngon sum yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod mi'i sems dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ khyod de nyams myong gi rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na min par thal/ khyod lha'i rgyud kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gal te de mi'i sems nyams su myong ba'i rang rig mngon sum yin par thal la ma khyab na/ de chos can/ khyod mi'i sems shes pa'i rang rig yin par thal/ khyod mi'i sems shes pa'i mngon shes gang zhig rang rig yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ mi'i sems de khyod dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ khyod mi'i sems shes pa'i rang rig gang zhig rang rig la rang las rdzas gzhan pa'i yul med par khyod rang gis khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /skye tshul gyi skabs su/ kho na re/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po 'gags pa'i gang zag yin na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa'i gang zag yin dgos par thal/ de gnyis skye 'gags gnas gsum cig car du byed pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis gzugs skad cig ma dang po gzung don byas pa las skyes pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis kyi gzung don yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod lan byas pa la/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag chos can gyis shog rtags chos can gyis 'grub/ 'dod byas pa la/ de chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ khyod de gnas pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags de la chos can yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab tshul la/ de chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab byas pa la/ bsal ba der thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon rang rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod rang rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir na 'dir ma khyab zer ba gal che/ rtags der thal/ gang zag gang zhig khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skyes pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma khyab na yang nus yod de/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes par thal/ khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa dang /

khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa gang rung gang zhig phyi ma de min pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon med par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig de gnyis skye 'gag gnas gsum cig car du byed kyang / gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po 'gags pa'i gang zag yin na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa'i gang zag yin pas ma khyab zer ro/ /de yang cung zad rnam dpyod mtshungs pa tsam yin te/ de la khyab pa yod par thal/ /gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skye ma thag pa'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags kha ma'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste skyes pa kho na 'jig pa yin/ /zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ de chos can/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gag kha ma'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'jig kha ma'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de 'jig kha ma'i gang zag yod pa gang zhig khyod de skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste de 'jig pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang de chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gag kha ma'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod 'gags pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de 'gag bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste dpal ldan zla bas/ 'gag bzhin pa ni yod kyang 'jig la phyogs par 'dod gyur pa/ /zhes pa'i bstan don grub pa'i phyir/ yang / gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag de gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gag bzhin pa'i gang zag yin par thal/

gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skye kha ma'i gang zag de gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ gzugs 'dzin dbang dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag de gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags don gyis dngos/ yang gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skye kha ma'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir la ma khyab na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skye kha ma'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ de de skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rtags bsal dngos/ yang gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skye kha ma'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yin par thal la ma khyab na/ bsal ba der thal/ de skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yod pa gang zhig gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag de de min pa'i phyir/ ma grub na de chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod chos de skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ de skye bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos gong de la khyab pa yod de/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ skye bzhin pa de skye la phyogs pas yod min zhing / /'gag bzhin pa ni yod kyi 'jig la phyogs pa 'dod gyur pa/ /zhes pa'i gzhung gi bstan don grub pa'i phyir/ de ltar byas pa la kho na re/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skyes pa'i gang zag yin na/

/'dod na/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te chos can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du grags ngor ma khyab byas pa la kho na re/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin na/ de dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes pa'i gang zag de/ de skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de de skyes pa'i gang zag dang / de de gnas pa'i gang zag de 'gags pa'i gang zag gsum po gang rung gang zhig de gnas pa'i gang zag kyang ma yin/ de 'gags pa'i gang zag kyang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin par thal lo/ /gsum pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon 'gags pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa 'gags pa'i gang zag gang zhig gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang / de dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa gnyis dus mnyam du 'gags pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis dus ma nyam du skyes pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis 'gags pa'i gang zag gang zhig de gnyis dus mnyam du 'gags pa'i phyir la ma khyab byas na/ 'o na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skye kha ma'i gang zag de/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa 'gags kha ma'i gang zag yin par thal/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes pa'i gang zag de de 'gags pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na chos can/

/yang rtog pa dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i rnam mkhyen skyes pa'i sangs 'phags chos can/ khyod rtog pa 'gags pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ de 'gags pa'i gang zag gang rung yin/ de skyes pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod rtog pa rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag dang / rtog pa rgyud la mi ldan pa'i gang zag gang rung yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma dngos/ 'dod na/ rtog pa de khyod kyi dus su 'gags par thal/ khyod rtog pa 'gags pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtog pa chos can/ khyod rtog pa dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i rnam mkhyen skyes pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dus su ma 'gags par thal/ khyod de'i dus yod pa'i phyir te/ khyod de skyes pa'i dus su yod pa'i phyir te/ khyod de dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rnam mkhyen dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i rtog pa skyes pa'i so so skye bo chos can/ khyod rnam mkhyen skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ /khyod rnam mkhyen dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i rtog pa skyes pa'i gang zag gang zhig rnam mkhyen dang rnam mkhyen dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i rtog pa gnyis skye 'gag gnas gsum cig car du byed pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab/ 'dod na/ khyod sangs 'phags yin par thal/ khyod rnam mkhyen thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po dngos/ ma khyab mtshams la/ de chos can/ khyod rnam mkhyen skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de skyes pa'i gang zag dang de 'gags pa'i gang zag gang rung yin/ phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ gang rung yin par thal/ gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod rang rgyud la rnam mkhyen skyes myong ba'i gang zag yin par thal lo zer na ma khyab byas pa la/ 'o na de rnam mkhyen 'gags ma thag pa'i gang zag yin par thal/

rnam mkhyen 'gags pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na rnam mkhyen dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i rtog pa skye kha ma'i so so skye bo de/ rnam mkhyen 'gag kha ma'i gang zag yin par thal/ de 'dra'i rtog pa skyes ma thag pa'i so so skye bo de/ rnam mkhyen 'gags ma thag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rnam mkhyen 'gag bzhin pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na khyod de skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal lo/ /des na skye 'gag rgyu 'bras kyi rigs pa gtso bor byas na/ de 'dra'i so skye de/ rnam mkhyen rang rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag min yang / rnam mkhyen skyes pa'i gang zag yin te/ rnam mkhyen dang dus mnyam du skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pa dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i sangs 'phags de yang rtog pa rang rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag min yang / rtog pa skyes pa'i gang zag yin te/ de dang dus mnyam du skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ des na de dang de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin par thal/ de dang de skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ ma khyab byas na dka' ba'i gnad las grol ba yin mod/ blo chung mang po dag gi blor shong ba dka' bas/ re zhig snga ma ltar skyongs shing / phyis shes pa rnal du phebs na gzhung lam la phyin pas chog go /yang khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gang zhig khyod de dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gang zhig khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/

/'dod na min par thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig 'di rigs la khyab pa med zer te/ mig g.yas g.yon la brten pa'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma snga phyi gnyis rgyud ldan yod pa'i phyir zer ba'ang yod mod/ de 'dra re tsam yod du chug na'ang / gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po nas/ brgya sogs grangs med yod pas de rnams skyes pa'i gang zag de rnams cig car rgyud ldan yin pa ha cang thal ches so/ /gal te rtsa ba la ma khyab zer na'ang gnad 'dra zhing khyad par med do/ /'o na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa skyes pa'i gang zag chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gang zhig khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i phyir/ khyab pa bshags pa yin pas dngos 'gal/ dang po der thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po skyes pa'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa ni rtsa ba'i dam bca' rang la dngos/ 'dod na/ khyod de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin par thal lo/ /zer na/ gzhung lam pa tsho 'dir ma khyab byas na bde mo gcig gda'/ ri bong cal rjes 'brang ba tsho la khyab pa byung / 'dod na/ min par thal/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma gnyis pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/
